name: Keep my nose to the grindstone

meaning.zh:
“埋头苦干” 或 “辛苦工作”。

这个短语起源于磨石匠工作的场景，他们必须非常专心地靠近磨刀石，确保工具被磨得锋利而平整。后来这个情景比喻为全神贯注地工作和努力工作，因此常用来形容某人一直专注于勤劳工作、不懈努力。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the scenario of a grindstone worker who would keep his nose near the grindstone to ensure the tool he was sharpening stayed sharp and even. This scenario metaphorically evolved to describe diligent and focused work, where someone is continually working hard and persistently.

lines.en: If you want to succeed, you have to keep your nose to the grindstone.
lines.zh: 如果你想成功，你就必须埋头苦干。

lines.en: He kept his nose to the grindstone for months to finish the project on time.
lines.zh: 他几个月来一直埋头苦干，以按时完成项目。

lines.en: She keeps her nose to the grindstone, never letting distractions get in her way.
lines.zh: 她总是埋头苦干，从不让分心的事物打扰她。
